Faq.title: Straight answers.
Faq.q1: What happens after I click Start Project?
Faq.a1: You complete a secure checkout with Lemon Squeezy. You then receive a short brief, and the 14-day clock starts once your brief is in.
Faq.a2: Yes. One flat fee covers everything listed in the plan. Anything outside that scope is quoted before work starts, never added silently.
Faq.a3: Yes. You receive the full source code and deploy it on your own hosting account. No retainer is needed to keep it running.
Faq.q4: Which languages can the site support?
Faq.a4: Multilingual routing, localized metadata and structured data come built in. We set up the languages you choose, up to five.
Faq.q5: Can I ask questions before I pay?
Faq.a5: Of course. Use the form below and we’ll get back to you.

Legal.privacyIntro: This notice explains which personal data this website processes and why.
Legal.p2: If you write to us, we process your name, work email, optional company name, message and chosen language to answer your request. The message is delivered to our team through [DELIVERY SERVICE, e.g. email or CRM provider]. Legal basis: taking steps at your request and our legitimate interest in answering enquiries.
Legal.p3: Our hosting provider processes technical request data, including your IP address, to deliver and protect the site. We use your IP address only for short-lived rate limiting that blocks abusive traffic.
Legal.p4: We set one functional cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, to remember your language for up to one year. We use no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.
Legal.p5: Payments are handled by Lemon Squeezy, which acts as merchant of record. When the page has finished loading, your browser fetches a script from Lemon Squeezy, and when you open checkout it connects to their servers. Their privacy policy applies to that data.
Legal.p6: We keep contact messages for [RETENTION PERIOD] unless a contract is concluded, in which case statutory retention periods apply.
Legal.p7: Under applicable data-protection law (for example GDPR or KVKK) you can request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your data, object to processing, and complain to your supervisory authority. Contact us at [EMAIL].
